title: 'The Interview': Sandra Oh Knows What's Great About Middle Age

sentences.zh: 七十年的太空探索。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, this is The Interview.
sentences.zh: 这里是《纽约时报》的《访谈》节目。

sentences.en: I'm Lulu Garcia Navarro.
sentences.zh: 我是露露·加西亚-纳瓦罗。

sentences.en: One of the most freeing parts of being a woman in middle age is letting go of all the stuff that weighed you down earlier in your life.
sentences.zh: 中年女性最自由的部分之一，就是放下那些早年生活中让你感到沉重的一切。

sentences.en: By this point, we've achieved quite a bit.
sentences.zh: 到了这个阶段，我们已经取得了不少成就。

sentences.en: We've learned quite a bit about who we are.
sentences.zh: 我们对自己是谁已经有了相当多的了解。

sentences.en: And we've also learned quite a bit about ignoring those who would try and limit us.
sentences.zh: 我们也学会了如何忽略那些试图限制我们的人。

sentences.en: We're kind of whittling ourselves down to what matters.
sentences.zh: 我们正在精简自己，只留下真正重要的东西。

sentences.en: Actor Sandra Oh knows all about that journey.
sentences.zh: 演员吴珊卓非常了解这段旅程。

sentences.en: She's best known for the 10 seasons she spent on Grey's Anatomy, playing the career-defining role of Dr. Christina Yang.
sentences.zh: 她最广为人知的角色是《实习医生格蕾》中饰演了10季的克里斯蒂娜·杨医生，这是一个定义了她职业生涯的角色。

sentences.en: After she left the show, she then played Eve Palastri in Killing Eve, an intelligence operative in the UK tasked with tracking an elusive and entrancing female assassin.
sentences.zh: 离开该剧后，她在《杀死伊芙》中饰演了伊芙·波拉斯特里，一名在英国负责追踪一位难以捉摸且迷人的女杀手的特工。

sentences.en: And this summer, she'll be on stage in Shakespeare in the Park in New York City.
sentences.zh: 今年夏天，她将登上纽约市“公园里的莎士比亚”舞台。

sentences.en: She's playing Olivia in Twelfth Night.
sentences.zh: 她将在《第十二夜》中饰演奥利维亚。

sentences.en: None of those characters were originally written to be played by an Asian woman.
sentences.zh: 这些角色最初都不是为亚裔女性编写的。

sentences.en: But Oh has broken barriers and paved the way for many of the Asian actors who have followed.
sentences.zh: 但吴珊卓打破了障碍，为后来许多亚裔演员铺平了道路。

sentences.en: Even as she says, now in her 50s, she's still processing what it took to get there.
sentences.zh: 正如她所说，现在50多岁的她，仍在消化自己走到今天所经历的一切。

sentences.en: As we do regularly on the show, I sat down with Oh twice.
sentences.zh: 正如我们在节目中经常做的那样，我和吴珊卓进行了两次坐谈。

sentences.en: The first time was in front of a live audience at the Tribeca Festival.
sentences.zh: 第一次是在翠贝卡电影节的现场观众面前。

sentences.en: The second was a few days later, just the two of us.
sentences.zh: 第二次是几天后，只有我们两个人。

sentences.en: We talked about her career, aging, DEI.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论了她的职业生涯、衰老以及多元、公平与包容（DEI）。

sentences.en: And for the first time publicly, she read from her personal diaries about key moments in her life and how she looks back on them now.
sentences.zh: 而且她第一次公开朗读了她的个人日记，记录了她生命中的关键时刻以及她现在如何回顾这些往事。

sentences.en: Now, here's my conversation with Sandra Oh.
sentences.zh: 现在，请听我和吴珊卓的对话。

sentences.en: This is exciting.
sentences.zh: 这太令人兴奋了。

sentences.en: This is how we were on the couch backstage.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们在后台沙发上的样子。

sentences.en: Yeah, we just had a conversation on the couch, which was, we went deep faSt.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我们刚才在沙发上聊天，聊得非常深入。

sentences.en: I was reading about you, of course, in advance of this conversation, and I came across this really great quote from 2019.
sentences.zh: 当然，在这次对话之前我读过关于你的资料，我偶然发现了2019年的一句非常棒的话。

sentences.en: You were one of Time Magazine's 100 Most Influential People.
sentences.zh: 你是《时代》杂志评选的100位最具影响力人物之一。

sentences.en: Shonda Rhimes, who of course is the creator of Grey's Anatomy, wrote your entry, and she said, and I'm quoting here,
sentences.zh: 当然，《实习医生格蕾》的创作者珊达·瑞姆斯为你写了入选词，她说——我引用一下：

sentences.en: Sandra Oh is a virtuoso.
sentences.zh: “吴珊卓是一位大师。”

sentences.en: She treats dialogue like notes of music.
sentences.zh: “她把台词处理得如同音符一般。”

sentences.en: And then just recently, you met Megan Thee Stallion at a gala.
sentences.zh: 最近，你在一次晚宴上遇到了梅根·西·斯塔莉安。

sentences.en: And when she saw you, and I'm juxtaposing this for a reason, she said, the icon, the legend, wow, my whole year's made, I don't have to do anything else.
sentences.zh: 我之所以把这件事放在一起说是有原因的，当她看到你时，她说：‘偶像，传奇，哇，我这一年都圆满了，我什么都不用做了。’

sentences.en: How do you feel about that when people see you and are just overwhelmed?
sentences.zh: 当人们见到你并表现得如此激动时，你有什么感觉？

sentences.en: I really take that question to heart because it's taken me a long time to actually really receive it.
sentences.zh: 我真的把这个问题放在心上了，因为我花了很长时间才真正学会接受它。

sentences.en: I don't usually pay attention, and I don't usually listen to it, and I've, you know, coming into, deep into our midlife,
sentences.zh: 我通常不怎么关注，也不怎么听这些评价，而且你知道，进入中年之后，

sentences.en: I'm needing to listen to things that somehow I felt like I need to protect myself from, either because I want it so badly or I just don't believe it.
sentences.zh: 我需要去倾听那些我曾经觉得需要自我保护而拒绝的东西，要么是因为我太渴望得到，要么就是我不相信。

sentences.en: And I think a part of being a full person in midlife is to actually hear the positive things or one's effect on people.
sentences.zh: 我认为中年时期作为一个完整的人，一部分就是要真正听到积极的评价，或者了解自己对他人的影响。

sentences.en: And so I think I'm still working on it to receive it.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我还在努力学会接受它。

sentences.en: You know, in Twelfth Night, there's this one little passage that I've been working on, and I work on it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在《第十二夜》里，有一小段台词我一直在琢磨，我一直在练习。

sentences.en: It's in Act 5, Scene 1, and Olivia is speaking to Viola, who's pretending to be Cesario, and she says,
sentences.zh: 那是第五幕第一场，奥利维亚对薇奥拉（她假扮成塞萨里奥）说：

sentences.en: Fear not, Cesario, take thy fortunes up.
sentences.zh: “不要害怕，塞萨里奥，去接受你的命运吧。”

sentences.en: Be that thou knowest thou art, and then thou art as great as that thou feareSt.
sentences.zh: “做你所知道的你自己，那么你就会像你所恐惧的那样伟大。”

sentences.en: So for me, it's always a clue for me I can't remember a line, like I have to work on it, because there's something in the line that I need to somehow ingest or understand.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，如果我记不住台词，那总是一个线索，我必须去钻研它，因为台词里有些东西我需要以某种方式吸收或理解。

sentences.en: I don't understand that line quickly enough.
sentences.zh: 我没能足够快地理解那句台词。

sentences.en: But in that is actually, I think, the answer to your question, which is what I'm trying to work with, which is to not be afraid and to take thy fortunes up.
sentences.zh: 但我想，答案就在其中，也就是我正在努力实践的：不要害怕，去接受你的命运。

sentences.en: Were you afraid of it going to your head, or were you feeling like you didn't deserve it?
sentences.zh: 你当时是害怕自己会飘飘然，还是觉得受之有愧？

sentences.en: I feel like it threw me off balance.
sentences.zh: 我觉得它让我失去了平衡。

sentences.en: I feel like I couldn't keep focusing on just the work, that there was something about it that was sometimes it's a,
sentences.zh: 我觉得我无法继续专注于工作本身，因为有些东西……有时候它是一种……

sentences.en: you're dealing with a projection that can be a little overwhelming.
sentences.zh: 你在处理一种可能会让人感到有些不知所措的投射。

sentences.en: And I think I needed to kind of build my interior self to be able to stand steady with it.
sentences.zh: 我想我需要建立起我的内心世界，才能稳稳地面对它。

sentences.en: So we're here in New York, but you live in Los Angeles,
sentences.zh: 我们现在在纽约，但你住在洛杉矶，

sentences.en: and you, like many people, had to evacuate your home during the wildfires earlier this year.
sentences.zh: 而且像许多人一样，今年早些时候野火期间你不得不撤离家园。

sentences.en: Oh, no, we didn't have to evacuate, but we were on standby, yes.
sentences.zh: 哦，不，我们没有撤离，但我们处于待命状态，是的。

sentences.en: You were on standby.
sentences.zh: 你们处于待命状态。

sentences.en: You were thinking about it.
sentences.zh: 你们当时在考虑这件事。

sentences.en: Oh, yes.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: And we chatted before this event,
sentences.zh: 我们在这次活动前聊过，

sentences.en: and you told me how you had to make this difficult decision about what to take with you if you were going to have to leave.
sentences.zh: 你告诉我，如果必须离开，你不得不做出一个艰难的决定，即带走什么。

sentences.en: Can you tell me that story, what happened?
sentences.zh: 你能讲讲那个故事吗？发生了什么？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: It was a tough time for everyone.
sentences.zh: 那对每个人来说都是一段艰难的时期。

sentences.en: And we were close to one of the fires, so then it was like, what are we going to pack in our car?
sentences.zh: 我们离其中一场火灾很近，所以当时就在想，我们要往车里装什么？

sentences.en: And the first thing that I thought was, I went to, honestly, my journals.
sentences.zh: 我首先想到的是，老实说，我去找了我的日记。

sentences.en: I have journals since 1982, so there's a lot of them.
sentences.zh: 我从1982年就开始写日记了，所以有很多本。

sentences.en: And then I thought, I can't take them all.
sentences.zh: 然后我想，我不能全带走。

sentences.en: Which ones do I take?
sentences.zh: 我该带哪几本？

sentences.en: Do I take the first ones?
sentences.zh: 带最早的那些吗？

sentences.en: Do I take the past 10 years, the last 10 years?
sentences.zh: 带过去10年的，还是最近10年的？

sentences.en: And, you know, it just makes you think, what are the things that are very, very important to you?
sentences.zh: 你知道，这让你思考，什么对你来说才是真正、真正重要的东西？

sentences.en: And I think that was the first thing that I thought about.
sentences.zh: 我想那是我第一个想到的东西。

sentences.en: After you told me that story, I did ask you to bring some of those diaries with you, and we're going to be reading from some of them.
sentences.zh: 在你告诉我那个故事后，我确实请你带了一些日记过来，我们要读其中的一些片段。

sentences.en: And I want to start with an excerpt from a momentous day in your career.
sentences.zh: 我想从你职业生涯中一个重要时刻的摘录开始。

sentences.en: This was your last day on Grey's Anatomy, which you were on for 10 seasons.
sentences.zh: 这是你在《实习医生格蕾》的最后一天，你在那里待了10季。

sentences.en: 10 seasons, yeah.
sentences.zh: 10季，是的。

sentences.en: That's amazing.
sentences.zh: 太惊人了。

sentences.en: It was amazing.
sentences.zh: 确实很惊人。

sentences.en: And so, please.
sentences.zh: 那么，请吧。

sentences.en: Yeah, sure.
sentences.zh: 好的，没问题。

sentences.en: April 25th, 2014.
Yesterday was my very last day of work on Grey's Anatomy.
sentences.zh: 昨天是我在《实习医生格蕾》工作的最后一天。

sentences.en: It was joyous.
sentences.zh: 那是一段快乐的时光。

sentences.en: I waited for my call time.
sentences.zh: 我等待着我的通告时间。

sentences.en: I felt excited and jumpy to get to work.
sentences.zh: 我感到兴奋，迫不及待地想去工作。

sentences.en: I had my hug from Laura and my first, last makeup from Norm.
sentences.zh: 我得到了劳拉的拥抱，还有诺姆为我做的最后一次化妆。

sentences.en: Desiree and I danced to Michael Jackson in the trailer.
sentences.zh: 黛西莉和我还在拖车里跟着迈克尔·杰克逊的音乐跳舞。

sentences.en: It was fun.
sentences.zh: 很有趣。

sentences.en: I passed everything out and wrote some more cards.
sentences.zh: 我把东西都分发了出去，又写了一些卡片。

sentences.en: Grabbed a lousy lunch at the screening.
sentences.zh: 在放映室吃了顿糟糕的午餐。

sentences.en: Took lots of pictures, lots of hugs.
sentences.zh: 拍了很多照片，有很多拥抱。

sentences.en: Then after lunch, they surprised me with a ceremony thingy for me.
sentences.zh: 午餐后，他们给了我一个惊喜，为我举办了一个仪式小活动。

sentences.en: Tony and Joan, cake sheet and cider.
sentences.zh: 托尼和琼，还有蛋糕和苹果酒。

sentences.en: Very lousy, cheap and wonderful.
sentences.zh: 非常简陋、廉价，但很美妙。

sentences.en: Chris said words.
sentences.zh: 克里斯说了几句话。

sentences.en: Nicole and Brian and Carla gave me a framed call sheet and I got two boxes filled with notes and gifts from the crew.
sentences.zh: 妮可、布莱恩和卡拉给了我一张装裱好的通告单，我还收到了两个装满剧组人员纸条和礼物的盒子。

sentences.en: I was deeply moved.
sentences.zh: 我深受感动。

sentences.en: We shot my last scene in the OR with my Kev.
sentences.zh: 我们在手术室拍摄了我的最后一场戏，和我的凯夫一起。

sentences.en: I was in the gallery alone, tapping on the glass.
sentences.zh: 我独自在观察室里，敲着玻璃。

sentences.en: I'd tap on the glass, wave goodbye, and then I'd fold to the ground and close the work.
sentences.zh: 我敲了敲玻璃，挥手告别，然后瘫倒在地，结束了工作。

sentences.en: Then afterwards, Kev threw a little get-together with food and margaritas back in Tony's office area.
sentences.zh: 之后，凯夫在托尼的办公室区域举办了一个小聚会，有食物和玛格丽特酒。

sentences.en: We ended the evening all in a circle, gabbing and gabbing, telling such fun and horror stories.
sentences.zh: 我们晚上围成一圈，不停地聊天，讲着各种有趣和恐怖的故事。

sentences.en: So I'm interested in you saying that it was joyous.
sentences.zh: 我对你说那段时光是“快乐的”很感兴趣。

sentences.en: I don't hear maybe a lot of sadness.
sentences.zh: 我没听出多少悲伤。

sentences.en: This was the end of the biggest thing in your career.
sentences.zh: 这是你职业生涯中最大的一件事的终点。

sentences.en: Why were you so happy?
sentences.zh: 为什么你当时那么开心？

sentences.en: No, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不。

sentences.en: It's because, like, you know,
sentences.zh: 这是因为，你知道，

sentences.en: I'm still working on and figuring out what that decade of my life was.
sentences.zh: 我还在努力消化和弄清楚我生命中的那十年到底意味着什么。

sentences.en: Not everyone gets to know that they're leaving a show.
sentences.zh: 并不是每个人都能预知自己何时离开一部剧。

sentences.en: Yeah?
sentences.zh: 是吗？

sentences.en: And I was in, I think, a very, very fortuitous position, and I took advantage of it fully, meaning that I wanted to leave well.
sentences.zh: 我想我当时处于一个非常、非常幸运的位置，我充分利用了它，意思是我想体面地离开。

sentences.en: And I think that, for me, one of the proudest things that I have in my life is how I left the show, because I was as conscious as possible with all the crew members,
sentences.zh: 我认为，对我来说，我一生中最引以为傲的事情之一就是我离开这部剧的方式，因为我尽可能地与所有剧组成员保持了真诚的沟通，

sentences.en: and actually even with the public.
sentences.zh: 甚至是对公众也是如此。

sentences.en: I think I joined Instagram.
sentences.zh: 我想我当时加入了Instagram。

sentences.en: And it was basically to help people say goodbye as I was saying goodbye.
sentences.zh: 基本上是为了在我告别时，帮助观众们一起告别。

sentences.en: It was very, very, very thought out.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是经过非常、非常、非常深思熟虑的。

sentences.en: It's really, anyone who does, like, TVNR stuff, it's really, really hard to say goodbye because stuff is faSt.
sentences.zh: 真的，任何做电视行业的人都知道，告别真的非常非常难，因为事情发生得太快了。

sentences.en: You leave, you know, you end, you cut, and then you kind of go.
sentences.zh: 你离开，你知道，结束，喊停，然后你就走了。

sentences.en: But I actually really worked to say thank you to everyone and to leave on my own terMs.
sentences.zh: 但我确实努力去感谢每一个人，并按我自己的方式离开。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I want to break some news early here because you gave an interview this year where you said there's a chance you'd go back.
sentences.zh: 我想在这里提前爆个料，因为你今年接受采访时说，你有可能会回去。

sentences.en: What would it take?
sentences.zh: 需要什么条件？

sentences.en: Are we talking guest appearance or is Christina moving back to Seattle, Grace?
sentences.zh: 我们是在谈论客串，还是克里斯蒂娜要搬回西雅图格蕾医院？

sentences.en: No, you know what?
sentences.zh: 不，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I got to tell you.
sentences.zh: 我得告诉你。

sentences.en: Let me redefine that for a second.
sentences.zh: 让我重新定义一下。

sentences.en: What I have noticed, you know, this is 10 years out from leaving the show,
sentences.zh: 我注意到的是，你知道，这距离我离开该剧已经十年了，

sentences.en: is the deep appreciation that I have for the people who appreciate Christina and it is that love that has made me go,
sentences.zh: 我对那些欣赏克里斯蒂娜的人有着深深的感激，正是这种爱让我觉得，

sentences.en: oh, the fans really, really, really want it.
sentences.zh: 哦，粉丝们真的、真的、真的很想要她回来。

sentences.en: And for the first time, that's when I started opening up the idea.
sentences.zh: 这是我第一次开始考虑这个想法。

sentences.en: But for me, I think to really be true to the people who enjoy your work, you have to be true to yourself.
sentences.zh: 但对我来说，我认为要真正对得起喜欢你作品的人，你必须忠于自己。

sentences.en: So at this point, I don't think so.
sentences.zh: 所以目前来看，我觉得不会。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Sad face.
sentences.zh: 伤心的表情。

sentences.en: I want to go back to your roots.
sentences.zh: 我想回到你的根源。

sentences.en: You grew up in Canada.
sentences.zh: 你在加拿大长大。

sentences.en: Your parents moved there from Korea.
sentences.zh: 你的父母从韩国搬到那里。

sentences.en: Your mom was a biochemiSt.
sentences.zh: 你妈妈是一位生物化学家。

sentences.en: Your dad was a businessman.
sentences.zh: 你父亲是个商人。

sentences.en: Clearly both very driven people.
sentences.zh: 显然，他们俩都非常有干劲。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: How did they influence some of your early ambition?
sentences.zh: 他们是如何影响你早期的抱负的？

sentences.en: You know, I think that's a part about when you grow up a child of immigrants, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我觉得这是移民子女成长过程中会有的经历，对吧？

sentences.en: You know, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我也不确定。

sentences.en: Maybe I can't say that because you grow up a child of immigrants.
sentences.zh: 也许我不能这么说，因为你是作为移民子女长大的。

sentences.en: Like, you see your parents work so hard.
sentences.zh: 比如，你看着父母工作得那么辛苦。

sentences.en: There is something to that.
sentences.zh: 这确实有些影响。

sentences.en: I grew up as a child of immigrants and there is something about that.
sentences.zh: 我是作为移民子女长大的，那种感觉确实很特别。

sentences.en: And you know what you have and you know what you don't have.
sentences.zh: 你知道自己拥有什么，也知道自己缺少什么。

sentences.en: And then you can also see that what you want in your life and that you realize you cannot bother people for that.
sentences.zh: 然后你也会明白自己生活中想要什么，并且意识到不能为了这些去麻烦别人。

sentences.en: You have got to go do it yourself.
sentences.zh: 你必须靠自己去争取。

sentences.en: I'm not sure.
sentences.zh: 我不确定。

sentences.en: You know, I would say that I think that I did get a very high dose of ambition and drive.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我想说，我觉得我确实从父母那里获得了非常强烈的抱负和动力。

sentences.en: I actually think that comes a lot from my dad.
sentences.zh: 我其实觉得这很大程度上来自我父亲。

sentences.en: But also my parents are very religious.
sentences.zh: 但我的父母也非常虔诚。

sentences.en: And there's something equal in that because their belief that you do something for the good of humanity was a big thing in our family.
sentences.zh: 这其中也有相似之处，因为他们坚信为人类福祉做贡献是我们家庭的一件大事。

sentences.en: How you grow up, what you're supposed to do and the responsibility that you have to do good.
sentences.zh: 你的成长方式、你应该做的事，以及你必须行善的责任感。

sentences.en: And I think that also really, really influenced us.
sentences.zh: 我认为这也真的、真的影响了我们。

sentences.en: You've described yourself as a very emotional child.
sentences.zh: 你曾形容自己是个非常感性的孩子。

sentences.en: And you brought another diary entry that speaks to that.
sentences.zh: 你还带来了另一篇日记，印证了这一点。

sentences.en: Can you explain when this is from?
sentences.zh: 你能解释一下这是什么时候写的吗？

sentences.en: Yes, this is my very first entry.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是我的第一篇日记。

sentences.en: And I just want to actually maybe prompt it with, don't worry.
sentences.zh: 我其实想先打个预防针，别担心。

sentences.en: Sunday, the 3rd of October, 1982.
sentences.zh: 1982年10月3日，星期日。

sentences.en: Dear Aerie, I hate myself.
sentences.zh: 亲爱的Aerie，我讨厌我自己。

sentences.en: That's all.
sentences.zh: 就这些。

sentences.en: Oh yeah, I also think I'll commit suicide.
sentences.zh: 哦对了，我还想自杀。

sentences.en: Spelled S-U-C-I-C-I-D-E.
sentences.zh: 自杀的拼写是S-U-C-I-C-I-D-E。

sentences.en: Nothing is worth living for.
sentences.zh: 没有什么值得活下去的。

sentences.en: I'm no good at anything.
sentences.zh: 我什么都做不好。

sentences.en: I'm never happy anymore.
sentences.zh: 我再也不快乐了。

sentences.en: I try so hard, but I never succeed.
sentences.zh: 我努力过了，但我从没成功过。

sentences.en: Succeed, spelled S-U-C-C-I-D-E.
sentences.zh: 成功的拼写是S-U-C-C-I-D-E。

sentences.en: Mom and dad always laugh at me when I try.
sentences.zh: 当我努力时，爸爸妈妈总是嘲笑我。

sentences.en: I do stupid mistakes.
sentences.zh: 我总是犯蠢错误。

sentences.en: Mom always yells at me.
sentences.zh: 妈妈总是对我大吼大叫。

sentences.en: I have no self-confidence.
sentences.zh: 我没有自信。

sentences.en: I don't believe in myself.
sentences.zh: 我不相信自己。

sentences.en: I can't do anything.
sentences.zh: 我什么都做不了。

sentences.en: Someday I'll run real far, so far that no one will ever find me.
sentences.zh: 总有一天我会跑得远远的，远到没人能找到我。

sentences.en: I have a lot of thoughts, but I can't write them all down.
sentences.zh: 我有很多想法，但我写不完。

sentences.en: I hate myself.
sentences.zh: 我讨厌我自己。

sentences.en: Monday, the 4th of October.
sentences.zh: 10月4日，星期一。

sentences.en: A great day!
sentences.zh: 美好的一天！

sentences.en: Don't worry, I turned out okay.
sentences.zh: 别担心，我后来过得挺好的。

sentences.en: When you were revisiting this, were you surprised?
sentences.zh: 当你重温这些时，感到惊讶吗？

sentences.en: I gotta tell you, I just have so much compassion for that young person.
sentences.zh: 我得告诉你，我对那个年轻的自己充满了同情。

sentences.en: And honestly,
sentences.zh: 老实说，

sentences.en: I'm so pleased with myself that at 11, with so much feeling, that I unconsciously found some place to regulate myself, which was writing.
sentences.zh: 我很欣慰，11岁的我带着如此强烈的情感，无意识地找到了一个调节自己的地方，那就是写作。

sentences.en: I remember my mom didn't like it because I would always be writing, and she knew it was about her.
sentences.zh: 我记得妈妈不喜欢这样，因为我总是在写，她知道那是关于她的。

sentences.en: You know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你明白我的意思吗？

sentences.en: It's like, she knew.
sentences.zh: 就像是，她心里清楚。

sentences.en: It's like, why are you always writing?
sentences.zh: 就像是，你为什么总是在写？

sentences.en: And I think that has just been
sentences.zh: 我认为这一直是一个

sentences.en: a receptacle that started out as an unconscious place to feel safe, but eventually has helped me figure out who I am.
sentences.zh: 容器，起初是一个无意识的避风港，但最终帮助我找到了自我。

sentences.en: You know, there is a sense of a little girl who is just figuring herself out, possibly having a bad day, but also someone who feels deeply and connects deeply with herself
sentences.zh: 你知道，这体现了一个小女孩正在探索自我，可能那天过得很糟糕，但她也是一个情感丰富、与内心紧密相连的人，

sentences.en: and maybe the world around her.
sentences.zh: 也许也与她周围的世界相连。

sentences.en: Did you know that you needed to have like artistic expression, that you needed to sort of have that kind of creative outlet when you were a kid?
sentences.zh: 你小时候就知道自己需要艺术表达，需要那种创造性的宣泄出口吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I think I knew it real young.
sentences.zh: 我想我很小的时候就知道了。

sentences.en: I know that I love performing and I love dancing, and I started ballet when I was four and I loved it.
sentences.zh: 我知道我热爱表演和跳舞，我四岁就开始跳芭蕾了，我非常喜欢。

sentences.en: I loved it.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢了。

sentences.en: And I just had so much feeling.
sentences.zh: 我当时情感太充沛了。

sentences.en: It was very hard to manage.
sentences.zh: 很难控制。

sentences.en: But I really remember my mom with this, like she would just let it all happen and just let it run its course.
sentences.zh: 但我真的记得我妈妈对此的态度，她只是顺其自然，让它自然发展。

sentences.en: But I think that when I think about or try and feel that young person,
sentences.zh: 但当我想起或试图感受那个年轻的自己时，

sentences.en: I think it was a natural thing that I found an avenue to be able to express that because I just had so much of it inside.
sentences.zh: 我认为我找到一个途径来表达这些情感是很自然的事，因为我内心积压了太多东西。

sentences.en: So there's a fun fact.
sentences.zh: 这里有个趣事。

sentences.en: At age 15, you were in an improv group called Skit Row High.
sentences.zh: 15岁时，你参加了一个叫“Skit Row High”的即兴表演团体。

sentences.en: That's true.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: A pun on Skid Row.
sentences.zh: 这是对“Skid Row”（贫民窟）的双关语。

sentences.en: And Alanis Morissette was briefly in the group because, of course, were you two friends?
sentences.zh: 艾拉妮丝·莫莉塞特也短暂地加入过这个团体，因为，你们俩当时是朋友吗？

sentences.en: I mean, do all Canadian famous people kind of come from the same place?
sentences.zh: 我是说，所有出名的加拿大人是不是都来自同一个地方？

sentences.en: Well, Canadians, we all know each other.
sentences.zh: 嗯，加拿大人，我们都互相认识。

sentences.en: I mean, that is kind of true.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这确实有点道理。

sentences.en: But, you know, Alanis came in very, very briefly to this group.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，艾拉妮丝只是非常、非常短暂地加入了这个团体。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: It's so great.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: It's so great.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Yeah, she came in, but she was also in the midst of like really a burgeoning music and musical career.
sentences.zh: 是的，她加入了，但当时她也正处于音乐事业蒸蒸日上的阶段。

sentences.en: So she just came in for like a couple of shows and we did, gosh, we performed shows where she would sing and some of us would be her backup singers.
sentences.zh: 所以她只参加了几场演出，天哪，我们表演的时候她唱歌，我们有些人给她当伴唱。

sentences.en: I'm not joking.
sentences.zh: 我没开玩笑。

sentences.en: Gosh.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Does anybody know her song
sentences.zh: 有人知道她的歌吗？

sentences.en: Fate Stay With Me?
sentences.zh: 命运与我同在？

sentences.en: Fate, fate, fate stay with me.
sentences.zh: 命运，命运，命运留在我身边。

sentences.en: I want to be, want to be, want to be.
sentences.zh: 我想成为，想成为，想成为。

sentences.en: I can't believe it.
sentences.zh: 我简直不敢相信。

sentences.en: I haven't thought about that since I was 15.
sentences.zh: 我从15岁起就没再想过这件事了。

sentences.en: I'm impressed.
sentences.zh: 我被惊艳到了。

sentences.en: But we would be on stage with her kind of like singing back up.
sentences.zh: 但我们当时确实在舞台上给她当伴唱。

sentences.en: It was actually a really super creative time, you know.
sentences.zh: 那真是一段超级有创造力的时光，你知道。

sentences.en: There were these guys who were in Second City in Toronto and they moved to Ottawa and they created this amazing
sentences.zh: 当时有多伦多“第二城”剧团的人搬到了渥太华，他们创造了这些神奇的

sentences.en: improv, improv games for kids.
sentences.zh: 即兴表演游戏，专为孩子们设计的。

sentences.en: And it started in Ottawa and then it grew to nationwide.
sentences.zh: 它始于渥太华，后来发展到了全国。

sentences.en: And I learned a lot.
sentences.zh: 我学到了很多。

sentences.en: I learned a lot from them.
sentences.zh: 我从他们身上学到了很多。

sentences.en: You became an American citizen in 2018 and you're now a dual citizen.
sentences.zh: 你于2018年成为美国公民，现在是双重国籍。

sentences.en: And you became a citizen so you could vote in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你成为公民是为了能在美国投票。

sentences.en: elections after Trump came into office.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普上任后的选举中。

sentences.en: I want to ask you about talking politics in this moment.
sentences.zh: 我想问问你关于当下谈论政治的问题。

sentences.en: Oh boy.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪。

sentences.en: Do you think there's a chilling effect now that people don't in Hollywood want to express themselves politically because things have changed?
sentences.zh: 你认为现在是否有一种寒蝉效应，好莱坞的人因为局势变化而不愿表达政治观点？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对有。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Do you think it's coming from a place where actors are self-censoring because they don't want to alienate certain groups?
sentences.zh: 你认为这是因为演员们在自我审查，不想疏远某些群体吗？

sentences.en: Or do you think it's coming from
sentences.zh: 还是说这来自

sentences.en: overhead where studios are sort of afraid of being penalized by this administration?
sentences.zh: 高层，制片厂担心受到本届政府的惩罚？

sentences.en: Oh, I don't think it's, I don't think it's as conscious as that.
sentences.zh: 噢，我不觉得，我不觉得有那么刻意。

sentences.en: You know, I think when you're a public figure,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为当你是一个公众人物时，

sentences.en: you understand that there are systems that are larger than you.
sentences.zh: 你会明白有些系统比你更强大。

sentences.en: You know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你明白我的意思吗？

sentences.en: And I think what's so difficult is that when you lose your story and you lose your narrative and you have no control over that, that is a very, very distressing place to be.
sentences.zh: 我认为最困难的是，当你失去了自己的故事，失去了叙事权，并且对此毫无控制力时，那是非常、非常令人痛苦的处境。

sentences.en: What you're always thinking about, am I going to lose my livelihood or then not feel safe?
sentences.zh: 你总是会想，我会不会失去生计，或者感到不安全？

sentences.en: Am I going to dox me or all that stuff?
sentences.zh: 我会不会被“人肉”或者诸如此类的事情困扰？

sentences.en: And so I think, again, people who have a public profile are always kind of managing that.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，同样地，有公众形象的人总是在应对这些问题。

sentences.en: But it's really because it's so easy to have things out of context, be misunderstood, and mostly losing one's own identity in someone else's or some other system's story.
sentences.zh: 但这确实是因为人们很容易断章取义、产生误解，最重要的是，在别人的故事或系统的叙事中迷失了自己的身份。

sentences.en: Do you think we're losing something by actors and actresses and others feeling afraid to actually be able to express themselves?
sentences.zh: 你认为演员们因为害怕而无法表达自我，我们是否因此失去了什么？

sentences.en: Or do you think actually it's better that they're not like opining?
sentences.zh: 还是说，他们不发表意见其实更好？

sentences.en: The thing is, some people can and some people want to.
sentences.zh: 问题是，有些人可以，有些人想表达。

sentences.en: And I understand that right now we're in the middle of an interview, right?
sentences.zh: 我明白我们现在正在采访中，对吧？

sentences.en: But my work is not to give an interview.
sentences.zh: 但我的工作不是接受采访。

sentences.en: It's a part of it, right?
sentences.zh: 这是工作的一部分，对吧？

sentences.en: My work for me is not to make statements.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，我的工作不是发表声明。

sentences.en: My work is to be an artist and to create stories, be a part of stories, make you feel things, make you feel connected, connect with material that you might not have thought about.
sentences.zh: 我的工作是成为一名艺术家，去创造故事，参与故事，让你感受到事物，让你感到共鸣，与你可能从未思考过的内容建立联系。

sentences.en: That's my work, right?
sentences.zh: 这就是我的工作，对吧？

sentences.en: I try and concentrate on that because that's my job.
sentences.zh: 我尽量专注于此，因为那是我的职责。

sentences.en: My job is to make you feel something.
sentences.zh: 我的职责是让你有所感触。

sentences.en: Then let's talk about your work because you're going to be in Shakespeare in the Park here in New York in one of my own favorite
sentences.zh: 那我们来谈谈你的工作吧，因为你即将在纽约的“公园莎士比亚”演出，那是我个人最喜欢的

sentences.en: Shakespeare plays,
sentences.zh: 莎士比亚剧目之一，

sentences.en: Twelfth Night.
sentences.zh: 《第十二夜》。

sentences.en: I played Mariah in high school.
sentences.zh: 我在高中时演过玛丽亚。

sentences.en: Lovely.
sentences.zh: 真好。

sentences.en: I'd be happy to know.
sentences.zh: 很高兴知道这一点。

sentences.en: This one is very starry.
sentences.zh: 这次阵容非常星光熠熠。

sentences.en: It has you, Lupita Nyong'o,
sentences.zh: 有你，露皮塔·尼永奥，

sentences.en: Peter Dinklage.
sentences.zh: 彼特·丁拉基。

sentences.en: So how is the rehearsal going?
sentences.zh: 那么排练进行得怎么样？

sentences.en: We haven't started yet.
sentences.zh: 我们还没开始呢。

sentences.en: You haven't started yet.
sentences.zh: 还没开始？

sentences.en: We haven't started yet.
sentences.zh: 我们还没开始呢。

sentences.en: Then how are you looking forward to?
sentences.zh: 那你对此有什么期待吗？

sentences.en: Oh my goodness.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪。

sentences.en: I mean, I will say I started learning this very early.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我得说我开始学习得非常早。

sentences.en: Finding myself deep into my midlife, the way that I learn things now and the way that I work is totally different.
sentences.zh: 当我步入中年，我学习和工作的方式已经完全不同了。

sentences.en: I need to, it doesn't stay in my head.
sentences.zh: 我需要，它记不住在我的脑子里。

sentences.en: It needs to enter my body.
sentences.zh: 它需要进入我的身体。

sentences.en: So I started learning these lines like probably in February.
sentences.zh: 所以我大概从二月份就开始背这些台词了。

sentences.en: Very slow.
sentences.zh: 非常慢。

sentences.en: I'm slow.
sentences.zh: 我很慢。

sentences.en: In February.
sentences.zh: 在二月份。

sentences.en: And it's just been a joy.
sentences.zh: 这真是一种享受。

sentences.en: And again, as I brought up earlier that quote, like when you have time to kind of just really, really play with and wonder what's underneath these words to my own life,
sentences.zh: 再说一次，就像我刚才提到的那句引语，当你真的有时间去揣摩、去思考这些词句背后与我个人生活的联系时，

sentences.en: it's just been joyous.
sentences.zh: 这真是一种快乐。

sentences.en: I mean, you play interesting women who are complicated, idiosyncratic, and a lot of Shakespeare is up to the actor's interpretation.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你饰演的女性角色都很有趣，复杂且独特，而且很多莎士比亚的角色都取决于演员的诠释。

sentences.en: So what are you thinking about for Olivia?
sentences.zh: 那么你对奥利维亚（Olivia）有什么想法吗？

sentences.en: Oh, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 噢，我不知道。

sentences.en: Who is she?
sentences.zh: 她是谁？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Oh, you don't know?
sentences.zh: 噢，你不知道？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: It's also like this.
sentences.zh: 情况也是这样。

sentences.en: I want to be very, very facile with the dialogue, right?
sentences.zh: 我想对台词非常非常熟练，对吧？

sentences.en: And then all you want to do is like to be as present as possible to whoever you're acting with.
sentences.zh: 然后你唯一想做的就是尽可能地与你的搭档保持当下的交流。

sentences.en: It's impossible to know kind of what you're going to do without the other person.
sentences.zh: 如果没有对方，你根本不可能知道自己会做出什么反应。

sentences.en: That's the thing about theater, right?
sentences.zh: 这就是戏剧的魅力，对吧？

sentences.en: It's like, you know, when you're on film, like I don't know how many times
sentences.zh: 就像，你知道，当你拍电影时，我不知道有多少次

sentences.en: I've acted to a piece of tape.
